victim_gender.reason: Victim Ashfaque Ahmad is described as the complainant's son, a male.

victim_caste.reason: No caste or community of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religion of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior enmity/dispute: the victim's father-in-law was a witness in an earlier s.302 IPC case against respondent Rajesh Vikram Singh
accused_victim_relationship.quote: his father-in-law was a witness in another criminal case registered against Rajesh Vikram Singh under Section 302 IPC
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Connection is indirect via father-in-law; value's framing as 'not stated' is muddled, though the prior-enmity content is supported.

offence_category.quote: It was alleged to be a case of contract killing.
offence_category.reason: Principal offence is murder (s.302 IPC) arising from a contract killing.

statutory_provisions.quote: 147, 148, 149, 307, 302, 120-B/34 IPC and Sections 3/4 of the Explosive Substances Act
statutory_provisions.reason: All listed IPC and Explosive Substances Act sections match the judgment.

weapon.quote: Two country made pistols, two magazines and one mobile phone were recovered
weapon.reason: Grenade thrown and country-made pistols used, as described in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: The occurrence has been witnessed by the appellant and two more eye witnesses.
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, recovery, interrogation disclosure and motive material are all referred to.

confession.correct_value: None (no confession). Disclosure by arrested accused Amit Chaubey implicated the respondent; the Court did not expressly say it disregarded this.
confession.quote: accused – Amit Chaubey disclosed that the respondent (Rajesh Vikram Singh) and his brother had sent the accused persons
confession.reason: Disclosure exists, but the claim that the Court did not rely on it is not stated in the judgment.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: The murder of Ashfaque Ahmad took place in broad day light.
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Daylight murder, contract killing, motive, criminal records and offence on bail are all noted.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: Learned Additional Advocate General informs that till date, only one witness has been examined.
trial_court_outcome.reason: No trial court verdict is stated; trial was ongoing with one witness examined.

high_court_outcome.quote: the applicant is entitled to be released on bail
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court granted regular bail to both respondents by orders dated 23.09.2021.

final_outcome.quote: the appeals are allowed, the impugned orders dated 23.09.2021... are hereby set aside
final_outcome.reason: No conviction or acquittal; bail orders set aside, so 'other' fits.

offence_finally_established.reason: No offence has been finally established against the accused.

imprisonment_type.quote: the impugned orders ... granting regular bail to the private respondents, are hereby set aside
imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence was imposed; 'none' is closer than 'not_stated' under this enum.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed-term sentence exists, so null is right.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Same content, but remove gendered pronouns (e.g. 'gave his name' should be 'gave a name' or 'gave the name').
neutral_facts.quote: One gave his name and the other did not.
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are accurate and outcome-neutral, but 'his' breaks the no-gender-pronoun rule.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the prescribed punishment.

attempt_completion.quote: Ashfaque Ahmad died on the spot
attempt_completion.reason: Main offence completed with the victim's death.

physical_harm.quote: Razi Ahmad @ Manu received injurie s.
physical_harm.reason: Death of victim and injuries to Razi Ahmad are both stated.

number_of_offences.quote: 147, 148, 149, 307, 302, 120-B/34 IPC and Sections 3/4 of the Explosive Substances Act
